traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Lycopodiaceae: evergreen herbs, sometimes epiphytic, with stems forking in pairs; leaves scale- or needle-like, each with a single vascular strand; sporangia in terminal cones or in the axils of the leaves (Huperzia), the spores all alike.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 87, family Lycopodiaceae: phyllotaxis pattern spiral, usually; read as {"spiral": "usually"}.

traits.leaf_division.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 87, family Lycopodiaceae: leaf division simple, sessile; read as "simple".

traits.life_span.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 87, family Lycopodiaceae: life span perennial; read as "perennial".
